# ARLing Motion

> Free, MIT licensed animated UI components for React and plain JavaScript. Each component follows the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices pattern for keyboard and screen readers (roles, states, focus, prefers-reduced-motion; screen reader checks are in progress), has no dependencies, and carries a 4 second demo timeline that can be painted at any moment with seek(t), so a headless browser can capture it frame by frame as video (the render script is planned for Pro). Install with the shadcn CLI: npx shadcn@latest add https://arling.sk/motion/r/<name>.json

Made by ARLing s. r. o., Bratislava, Slovakia. Site: https://arling.sk/motion/ . Contact: support@arling.sk

## Install

- shadcn CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add https://arling.sk/motion/r/tabs.json` (replace tabs with any name below). It adds `components/ui/motion-<name>.tsx` (React), `lib/arling-motion-<name>.js` (the logic, plain JavaScript) and `lib/arling-motion.js` (the core), each .js with a .d.ts, and puts the CSS under `@layer components` in the global stylesheet (Tailwind v4).
- Registry index (shadcn schema): https://arling.sk/motion/r/registry.json
- Without React or a build step: load `https://arling.sk/motion/components/<name>/<name>.css` and import `create<Name>` from `https://arling.sk/motion/components/<name>/<name>.js` as an ES module. The markup each component expects is documented at the top of its file.
- Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind: add the component CSS file yourself. Styles read the shadcn variables (--background, --foreground, --primary, --muted, --border, --ring, --radius) and fall back to neutral colours.

## Components

- [Dialog](https://arling.sk/motion/r/dialog.json): modal that grows out of the button that opened it and folds back into it; focus trap, Escape, focus returns to the button.
- [Tabs](https://arling.sk/motion/r/tabs.json): indicator whose leading edge moves first while the trailing edge catches up; arrow keys, Home, End; panels without layout shift.
- [Tooltip](https://arling.sk/motion/r/tooltip.json): one bubble for a group of triggers that slides and resizes between them; shows on keyboard focus, Escape hides it.
- [Dropdown menu and popover](https://arling.sk/motion/r/popover.json): unfold from the trigger, items enter one after another, one highlight slides between items; APG menu button keyboard.
- [Toast](https://arling.sk/motion/r/toast.json): grows out of the click point and folds into a stack; hover or focus unfolds it and pauses timers; polite live region; Alt+T.
- [Switch](https://arling.sk/motion/r/switch.json): thumb on a spring that stretches while pressed; the new colour grows as a circle from the press point.
- [Accordion](https://arling.sk/motion/r/accordion.json): panel unfolds downward and rows enter as the edge reaches them; single or multiple, collapsible.
- [Command menu](https://arling.sk/motion/r/command.json): Cmd+K palette that filters without a cut; combobox with an always visible listbox and aria-activedescendant.
- [Drawer](https://arling.sk/motion/r/drawer.json): bottom sheet that follows the pointer 1:1 and hands over to a spring with the release speed; flick to close; Escape and buttons always work.
- [Carousel](https://arling.sk/motion/r/carousel.json): drag and throw; the spring lands on the slide the throw points to; no auto rotation; APG carousel roles.
- [One-time code input](https://arling.sk/motion/r/otp.json): one real input under the slots (paste, autocomplete="one-time-code"); a valid code turns green as one growing circle.
- [Dropzone](https://arling.sk/motion/r/dropzone.json): unfolds into a file list row by row, folds back on Clear; lists File objects, uploads nothing.
- [Core](https://arling.sk/motion/r/core.json): closed-form springs (spring, PRESETS, springDisp, settleTime, cssEasing), track, indicator, presence, stagger, driver, beats; also adds the springs as CSS variables (--arling-spring-snappy and others).
- [Number](https://arling.sk/motion/r/number.json): a number that rolls to its new value digit by digit from the right; a new leading digit opens in width; locale separators; screen readers get the final value at once.
- [Island](https://arling.sk/motion/r/island.json): a status pill that reshapes between states, Dynamic Island style (for example paying, payment received, download ready); width and height on one spring with round ends, the old content leaves as the new one enters part by part, a spinner and a self drawing check that are functions of time; a polite status region for screen readers; nothing takes focus.
- [Segmented control](https://arling.sk/motion/r/segmented.json): a segmented control (a toggle group with one value, for example Monthly or Yearly, or a plan picker); one thumb moves in position and width on a single spring and continues from its current speed when you choose again mid flight; WAI-ARIA radio group with arrow keys, Home, End and a roving tabindex; data-equal for options of equal width.
- [Slider](https://arling.sk/motion/r/slider.json): a slider whose thumb grows while held and springs back on release, settling on the nearest step; a bubble shows the value through your formatter (for example "400 conversations" or "19 €") and stays inside the slider at the ends; WAI-ARIA slider with aria-valuetext, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End; pointer capture for mouse, pen and touch; horizontal, left to right.
- [Morph](https://arling.sk/motion/r/morph.json): a card that grows into a dialog and folds back into the card (FLIP, like a morphing dialog), for example a product in a catalogue; position and size move on one spring from the card's box to the dialog's, the card's text and the dialog's content cross fade under an inverse scale so nothing stretches, the corners stay round and the 1 px ring stays 1 px; closing mid flight turns around from the current speed; WAI-ARIA modal dialog with a focus trap, Escape, backdrop and Close, focus returns to the card.
- [Marquee](https://arling.sk/motion/r/marquee.json): an endless horizontal band (for example logos, products or tool names) whose position is a function of time; pointing at it or moving focus into it lets it coast to a stop on a spring and leaving picks the speed up again; keyboard focus glides the focused item into view; a pause button (WCAG 2.2.2); the content is copied just often enough to leave no gap and the copies are aria-hidden and inert; with reduced motion it stands and scrolls sideways; speed in px per second, direction left or right.

## How the motion works

- Every animated value is a pure function of time: a track keeps a list of target changes, and its value at time t is the sum of one closed-form spring per change. No frame-to-frame state, no animation library.
- Live, a driver draws with requestAnimationFrame only while something moves. For video, seek(t) paints any moment exactly; the frame at the end of a demo equals the first frame, so clips loop.
- With prefers-reduced-motion, nothing moves: components show each new state at once.
- Springs as CSS: https://arling.sk/motion/springs.css (CSS linear() easings with durations, generated from the core with 60 stops each; a test keeps them within 0.6 % of the spring).
- Demo canvas for any component at any time: https://arling.sk/motion/demo.html?c=tabs&t=1.25

## Pro (not on sale yet)

ARLing Motion Pro is planned at 49 EUR one-time: a video kit that renders any component demo to MP4 (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) on your own computer (Node, Chrome, ffmpeg), three blocks as website sections and video templates, a music generator for 120 BPM loops, and 12 months of updates. Pro is not MIT. There is no purchase link yet.

## Honest limits

- Eighteen components; far fewer than Magic UI or Aceternity UI.
- Tests run in Node against a simulated DOM (keyboard, ARIA after every change, reduced motion, seamless demo loops). Checks in real browsers and with screen readers are still in progress.
- Not in the shadcn directory yet, so the short form `npx shadcn add @arling/<name>` does not work yet; use the full URL.
